summary_md: **Pavel Kerbel ([@kerbelp](https://x.com/kerbelp/status/2115926771115634851))** argues a coding agent should know why an approach was rejected, which constraint ruled it out and where it applies, and points to **Metatron**, a git-native context layer for coding agents ([kerbelp/metatron](https://github.com/kerbelp/metatron)).

referenced_urls.title: GitHub - kerbelp/metatron: Git-native context layer for AI coding agents. Your team's real engineering decisions — patterns, pitfalls, conventions — live as reviewed markdown files in your repo; agents consult them before writing code and record what they learn.
